Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fixer round 3, topic r10-prepr-closures (PR #2528, branch fix/r10-prepr-closures, PR head 5332c59f9b5e883d1b1638a6f310fbc7237bdaa9; previous code ref refs/heads/handoff/r10-prepr-closures, body ref refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-prepr-closures). Group R10-PREPR-CLOSURES. Fix review blocked. Read the full verdict: git fetch origin probe/rev-2528-b5c87533 && git show origin/probe/rev-2528-b5c87533:verdict.md (evidence under ev/ on the same ref; git show origin/probe/rev-2528-b5c87533:ev/<file>). Per the three-round rule (this is round 3): re-cut the body minimal (only what the diff, the figures and the mutation table need; drop anything the reviewer verified and nothing disputes beyond a one-line figure). Two blocking items; everything else the reviewer verified (M0, M3wd, M3setm, M4sub, M1, M2, M6, cheap-checks figures) stays as is, re-derive only what your change touches.

1. Reap arms pin the recorder's leader pid, not its process group (item 61eab2a5, M7: changing `kill -TERM -- -"$rpid"` to `kill -TERM "$rpid"` leaves the self-test at 323/0). To unblock (reviewer's words): make the sleeper fork a child, as the recorder does (tests/derive_closures.sh:235 forks lanes as `( ... ) &`). Then require that child gone in every reap arm, and read it as gone by its state (`ps -o stat=` not Z), not by `kill -0`: PID 1 in the container leaves zombies unreaped and kill -0 counts them alive. The reviewer's probe is ev/lane-*.diff on the probe ref (the reviewer's instrument, not yours: build your own, it may be modelled on it). Show M7 failing, and passing unmutated; record in the mutation table.
2. Step 6b's own call site is not driven (item 3fc47a16, M9: putting prepr.sh:2945 back to `CLOSURES_LINE=$(closures_line "$BASE")` leaves 323/0). To unblock, either: have the driver reach the recorder through step 6b's own statement, or add a static pin that 6b calls `closures_step` and runs no `$(closures_line`. M9 must then fail; record it.
3. The reviewer's non-blocking note: the body's claim that carry_audit refuses the sibling-seam carry as BAD-DEST because R10-PREPR-CAP is done is stale (R10-PREPR-CAP is in-progress at roster 23ef06dc6). Re-cut: route that carry to a group that outlives this PR, or to the orchestrator's issue the body names (item 11113f3e).
 Then, always: merge current origin/main (never rebase) and PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; re-measure every figure your change touches at your new head; answer every red check at your head in ## Red checks (nightly-status grades main); follow dev/governance/roles/fixer.md; standing rule 19 on every observation (Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | dismissed: <reason 2+ words>, then (item <id>)), verified with python3 tools/audit/seat/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body <body.md>. Keep evidence you push small (no multi-hundred-KB outputs). Push code to handoff/r10-prepr-closures and the body with bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-prepr-closures <body.md>; the handoff-body push is your return signal.
